members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. Cells keep following their category when the data changes, so a new dataset flows instead of repainting.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name in the legend, the tooltip, and the data table.

members.name: value
members.doc: Raw amount. Shares are computed from the total; negatives count as zero.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. Defaults to the first series for accentKey, the supporting series for the next three, then neutral steps.

types.name: WaffleChartProps
types.doc: A unit chart: every cell is one share of the whole, so parts of a total read as countable squares.

members.name: data
members.doc: Categories in fill order. The first fills from the bottom-left corner, column by column.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the whole is, such as "Electricity generation, 2023". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each raw value in the tooltip and table, such as "TWh".

members.name: rows
members.doc: Grid rows. rows × columns cells make the whole; 10 × 10 means one cell per percent.

members.name: accentKey
members.doc: The category painted in the accent. Pass null to keep every category neutral. Defaults to the first category.

members.name: activeKey
members.doc: Controlled focused category. Others dim while one is focused.

members.name: legend
members.doc: Category list with shares that roll to their new value.
